statement: exp(Log 5) = 1 at 5, written as two lines: Log 5 = 0 at 5, then exp(0) = 1 at 5.
argument: Log(p^m w u) = log u (docs/SPEC.md:584), and 5 = 5^1 * 1 * 1, so Log 5 = log 1 = 0. The driver has no variables, so exp(Log 5) is written as Log 5 and then exp of the printed value 0. (5 ; 5 * [1]) is the idele of 5: real coordinate 5, finite part 5 times the exact unit 1 (docs/conventions.md 9.2).
